messages:
pagerbot: INCIDENT: elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate (prod, us-west1). Pager rule triggered (>=3x baseline, 2m). Paging oncall alex :rotating_light:
alex: on it. paging status? any initial impact metrics?
marta: seeing 5xx spike from runtime nodes: model-runner group 'mistral-48q' in us-west1. Error pattern: SIGSEGV and OOM for inference-worker.
alex: sounds like a runtime crash. any correlating deploys?
ryan: no deploys in the last hour. autoscaler did spin up a few nodes.
lina: adding logs from gateway showing backend 502/504 and some 500s:
```
[2026-03-15T12:01:42Z] upstream_response_time=1203ms status=502 backend=mistral-48q-03 pid=2243
[2026-03-15T12:02:05Z] upstream_response_time=8ms status=500 backend=mistral-48q-07 pid=3321 error="segfault"
[2026-03-15T12:02:07Z] upstream_response_time=5ms status=503 backend=mistral-48q-07 pid=3321 error="oom"
```
alex: good context. can we isolate by model version and batch size?
marta: yes — higher token lengths and batch sizes >8 correlate with most failures. tracing shows KV cache growth before SIGSEGV.
alex: mitigation options: 1) route traffic off mistral-48q pool to fallback smaller model (mistral-24q) 2) disable large-batch routing 3) drain and reprovision affected nodes. which should we do now?
ryan: immediate: switch routing for prod /v1/generate to fallback variant (mistral-24q) for canary of traffic. then drain affected nodes and run hotpatch.
lina: starting routing change now. updating routing policy:
```
# temp routing: prefer model_tag:mistral-24q when backend health < 90%
route update --route /v1/generate --fallback-model mistral-24q --weight 100
```
alex: notify CS and status page. customer-success please prepare a short customer note (possible elevated errors for some requests to hosted API, mitigation in progress).
customer-success: drafting now. asking for impact window and estimated ETA for full mitigation.
marta: draining node mistral-48q-07, launching reprovision job to replace with fresh image, collecting core dumps to S3: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/4445009999/
ryan: triggering autoscaler cooldown and setting max batch size to 4 in gateway config to reduce memory pressure:
```
# temp config
gateway.max_batch_size=4
gateway.seq_len_cap=1024
```
alex: good. Lina, confirm if 5xx rate drops after routing change.
lina: routing change applied at 12:05:13Z. observing drop in 5xx from 18% -> 3% over 90s. some residual 5xx from legacy endpoints.
pagerbot: NOTE: status page updated (incident id INC-4445009999) — Partial degradation for /v1/generate in us-west1.
customer-success: sent preliminary message to customers affected by SLA contract (large enterprise cohorts). they'll escalate if we have >30m impact.
marta: core dump analysis shows null deref in kv_cache->insert when seq_len > 2048. stack:
```
# simplified
segfault at 0x0
backtrace:
  0x7f8a2b1f model_runner+0x3a1
  0x7f8a2bff kv_cache_insert+0x8f
  0x7f8a3caa forward_pass+0x21c
```
alex: repro steps? can we trigger locally with long sequence?
ryan: running local repro with seq_len=4096 and batch=6 on isolated infra. reproduces segfault.
lina: while we plan a runtime hotfix, keeping fallback routing for all prod traffic to mistral-24q. impact: slightly higher latency, lower throughput but stable.
alex: assign hotfix to eng-runtime and eng-ml. Marta/ryan pair to implement guard for kv_cache insert and add seq_len checks to prevent unbounded growth. estimated 2-3 hours for patch + canary.
marta: starting branch and unit tests. also adding temporary kvcache defensive check to avoid null deref.
ryan: can we add a config-based cap so Private and Dedicated customers can opt-in? will add flag `runtime.kvcache.max_seq` default 2048.
customer-success: keeping customers updated. CS will mark follow-up update at +30m.
alex: handoff: I'm going to escalate to oncall second for night overlap at 12:40Z. Lina, pass logs and runbook to next oncall.
lina: copying runbook notes to thread:
- symptom: 5xx, SIGSEGV/OOM on model-runner group mistral-48q
- immediate mitigation: route to mistral-24q, cap batch size to 4, drain affected nodes
- next: hotpatch kv_cache insert guard, add seq_len cap, run canary, revert routing when stable
- customer comms: CS message sent, status page updated
- artifacts: core dumps s3://redwood-incident-dumps/4445009999/, gateway logs uploaded to /incidents/4445009999/logs

pagerbot: SCHEDULE: postmortem owner request — please add owner and severity.
alex: assigning postmortem to marta (severity SEV2). I'll create the doc once hotfix is verified.
marta: hotfix pushed to canary at 13:22Z, canary saw 0 crashes for 30m with batch=6, seq_len up to 4096; promoting to prod now.
lina: promoting back routing at 13:40Z, removing temporary caps. monitoring closely. 5xx baseline returned to ~0.5%.
customer-success: updated customers: issue mitigated, follow-up postmortem promised. no SLA violations expected after mitigation window of ~35m.
alex: great work. next steps: full postmortem, add regression tests for high sequence lengths and add telemetry alert for KV cache growth.
ryan: opening PR for runtime defensive checks and a test harness for long sequences.
marta: noted. will include changelog and rollout notes in postmortem.
pagerbot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: incident closed at 14:07Z (duration 1h6m)."
